mentions.name: ProofPod
mentions.description: This app makes testing (test & control experimentation) available to brick and mortar retailers, with a pipeline that fully automates choosing test and control locations using synthetic difference-in-differences.
mentions.problem: Testing has not been available to brick and mortar retailers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on an app to make testing available to all brick and mortar retailers (proofpod.ai).

The most difficult technical challenge has been designing a pipeline to fully automate choosing test & control locations using synthetic difference-in-differences.
